items.event: El Clásico: Barcelona vs Real Madrid (LaLiga)
items.line: Unbeaten league leaders Barcelona host Mourinho's Real Madrid at Camp Nou in his first Clásico back; a Barça win would open a nine-point gap. Barça are missing Koundé, García, Christensen and Olmo.
